name: Liberty Christian
overview: Scripture reveals the concept of liberty through the institution of the jubile, a sacred fiftieth year when liberty is proclaimed throughout the land, and every person returns to their possessions and family. During this year, the land rests from sowing and reaping, emphasizing holiness and rest in God's provision. The laws also instruct against oppression in transactions between neighbors, underscoring the importance of fairness and restoration within the community.
